process_name: Opening a Savings Account in Bangladesh
steps: Choose a bank and account type
Visit a branch in person
Provide National ID (NID) or passport, and a passport-size photo
Provide a nominee's details
Get an introducer (existing account holder to vouch for you)
Deposit the minimum opening balance
Receive a passbook and/or debit card

process_name: Opening a Savings Account in India
steps: Choose a bank and account type
Complete KYC — provide Aadhaar and PAN card
Apply online or in-branch via video KYC
Provide a passport-size photo and signature
Fund the account with the minimum balance if required
Receive a debit card and net/mobile banking access
notes: DUMMY DATA — placeholder for development. Replace with verified data before demo.

process_name: Opening a Savings Account in the Philippines
steps: Choose a bank (traditional or digital-only)
Provide at least one valid government ID
Provide Tax Identification Number (TIN) if available
Visit a branch or complete online application with selfie/video verification
Fund the account with the minimum initial deposit
Receive an ATM/debit card

process_name: Opening a Savings Account in the US (as a newcomer)
steps: Choose a bank (traditional, credit union, or online-only)
Provide a government-issued ID (passport + visa for newcomers)
Provide SSN, ITIN, or use a bank that accepts foreign passport/visa alone
Provide a US address (some banks accept temporary/campus address)
Apply online or in-branch
Fund the account with the minimum opening deposit if required
Receive a debit card by mail or immediate digital access
